record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.context_brief: Growth of Weyl-generated ideals for r >= 2.
record.original_question: For 1 <= r <= \infty, let L^{WEYL}_{r,\infty} be the quasi-Banach operator ideal defined by dyadic Weyl-number decay x_{2^k}(S)=O(2^{-k/r}), and let (L^{WEYL}_{r,\infty})^{APP}_{r,\infty} be the ideal obtained by applying the generalized approximation-number construction to L^{WEYL}_{r,\infty}. Determine whether the family (L^{WEYL}_{r,\infty})^{APP}_{r,\infty} strictly increases as r ranges over [2,\infty), or whether it becomes constant there; in particular, decide whether (L^{WEYL}_{2,\infty})^{APP}_{2,\infty}=L^{WEYL}_{1,\infty}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and notation. Let $S:X\to Y$ be a bounded linear operator between Banach spaces. For $n\ge 1$, the $n$-th Weyl number $x_n(S)$ is defined by
$$x_n(S)\;=\;\sup\{\,a_n(S\circ A)\;:\;A:\ell_2\to X,\;\|A\|\le 1\,\},$$
where $a_n(\cdot)$ denotes the $n$-th approximation number, i.e. $a_n(T)=\inf\{\|T-F\|:\operatorname{rank}F<n\}$.

For $1\le r\le \infty$ define the quasi-Banach operator ideal
$$L^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty}\;=\;\bigl\{\,S\;:\;\sup_{k\ge 0} 2^{k/r}\,x_{2^k}(S)<\infty\,\bigr\},$$
i.e. the class of operators whose dyadic Weyl numbers satisfy $x_{2^k}(S)=O(2^{-k/r})$.

Given any quasi-Banach operator ideal $\mathfrak A$ with quasi-norm $\|\cdot\|_{\mathfrak A}$, define for an operator $S:X\to Y$ the generalized approximation numbers
$$a_n^{(\mathfrak A)}(S)\;=\;\inf\{\,\|S-F\|_{\mathfrak A}\,:\,F\in\mathfrak A(X,Y),\;\operatorname{rank}F<n\,\},$$
and, for $1\le r\le\infty$, set
$$\mathfrak A^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}\;=\;\bigl\{\,S\in\mathfrak A\;:\;\sup_{k\ge 0} 2^{k/r}\,a_{2^k}^{(\mathfrak A)}(S)<\infty\,\bigr\}.$$

Problem. Consider the family of operator ideals
$$\bigl(L^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{r,\infty}\bigr)^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty},\qquad r\in[2,\infty).$$
Determine whether this family is strictly increasing in $r$ on $[2,\infty)$, or whether it is constant on $[2,\infty)$. In particular, decide whether the identity
$$\bigl(L^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{2,\infty}\bigr)^{\mathrm{APP}}_{2,\infty}\;=\;L^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{1,\infty}$$
holds.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open question about the behavior of the iterated Weyl/approximation-number ideal construction on Banach spaces. A web search did not turn up any subsequent work resolving the strict-monotonicity question on $[2,\infty)$ or the specific identity $(L^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{2,\infty})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{2,\infty}=L^{\mathrm{WEYL}}_{1,\infty}$, so it appears to remain open.

status_evidence.snippet: Collection of open problems concerning traces and operator ideals on Banach spaces, including questions on Weyl-generated ideals.
status_evidence.claim: The question is listed as an open problem regarding monotonicity of the Weyl-APP ideal family for r in [2,infty).
